RIS dispatch_ingress resolves any ACTIVE profile and cannot prove it belongs to the order owner/partner.
C.required: Server-side bind/validate apiProfileRef to the order owner/partner, or a signed server binding.

canaryStages.name: Isolated Analysis Executor Canary
canaryStages.scope: Direct analysis Lambda invoke with synthetic context; no API Gateway, no worker, no Mays order.

canaryStages.name: Authenticated RIS API/Worker Canary
canaryStages.scope: Verified API execute path through work queue and shared worker; no Mays order.

canaryCases.success: synthetic structured CV or owner PDF -> CVParserResultBody 1.0
canaryCases.denial: no parse.cv -> entitlement_denied; consent=false -> consent_required; foreign partner -> partner_mismatch
canaryCases.cleanup: delete synthetic CV object/job object, WorkItem and entitlement; restore deny env

canaryCases.denial: no parse.job -> entitlement_denied; consent=false -> consent_required; foreign partner -> partner_mismatch
canaryCases.cleanup: delete synthetic job object, WorkItem and entitlement; restore deny env

canaryCases.success: structured CV + job -> ComparisonResultBody 1.0; optional ats.tags -> ATSAnalysisResultBody 2.0
canaryCases.replay: same idempotencyKey -> idempotent=true, one CV + one job parse
canaryCases.denial: no compare.tags -> entitlement_denied; ats.tags without analyze.job -> entitlement_denied; consent=false -> consent_required
canaryCases.cleanup: delete synthetic CV/job objects, WorkItem and entitlement; restore deny env
